deck-a-commons-a: Grimy, lived-in used-future garbage barge. The aft common-room corridor that runs the spine of the top deck: worn rubber matting, a sagging vinyl bench, a notice-board furred with curling memos. The HERO of the shot, dead-centre and large, is a grimy framed DECK SCHEMATIC bolted to the riveted bulkhead under scratched glass: a hand-stencilled top-down CUTAWAY of all FOUR stacked decks of the ship — labelled Deck A command at top down to Deck D cargo hold at bottom — drawn in faded teal ink with little room boxes and a ladderway line, the one thing everyone reads. Flickering amber strip lighting and dead tubes, coffee rings, Red Dwarf comic register. No floating blocks, real readable ship cutaway, not just a nameplate.
deck-a-holo-bay: Grimy, lived-in used-future garbage barge, Red Dwarf comic register. A dingy cramped projector alcove with riveted scuffed steel walls, exposed conduit and ducting. The hero element: a humming HOLO-EMITTER PYLON throwing a flickering cyan light-projection of a prim, slightly translucent deceased crewman in a stiff blazer, standing on a worn circular RECHARGE PAD ring set into the grubby floor and painted with scuffed yellow hazard chevrons. Cables, a power junction box on the wall, faint volumetric haze. Cool projector flicker against amber emergency light. Properly textured grimy materials, NOT flat untextured blocks, not a clean studio.
deck-b-scrubber-corridor: Grimy, lived-in used-future garbage barge, Red Dwarf comic register. A narrow service corridor leading aft and down off the mess hall, single caged bulb, riveted steel walls with a 'SCRUBBER CONTROL — AUTHORIZED CREW' stencil. The HERO of the shot, foregrounded on the rubber-matted floor: a glistening greenish SLIME TRAIL smeared down the centre of the corridor, leading the eye straight to an open FLOOR HATCH in the deck plating at the far end — round hatch cover flipped back, darkness and a ladder dropping down into the crawlspace below. Ominous but mundane, flickering amber light, condensation, coral-tinged slime sheen.
deck-c-crawlspace: Grimy, lived-in used-future garbage barge, Red Dwarf comic register. The inside of a cramped, HOT service crawlspace / duct just big enough to crawl through: ribbed greasy metal tunnel, bundled cables and dripping pipes, a headlamp cone of light cutting the dark. The hero element, packed into a torn-open warm machinery intake in the wall: a clot of DOZENS of leathery, faintly GLOWING coral-red ALIEN EGGS, slime-strung and pulsing, clogging a SCRUBBER INTAKE grille — one egg cracked. Claustrophobic dread, condensation, warning stencils. Coral glow against grimy slate steel. NOT a clean empty concrete sewer pipe, no random balls on the floor.
deck-d-cargo-hold: Grimy, lived-in used-future garbage barge, Red Dwarf comic register, B-movie scale. A vast, freezing cargo hold. The FREIGHT is unmistakably spacecraft cargo, NOT brown moving boxes: towering stacked CARGO PODS and ribbed steel SHIPPING CONTAINERS of mixed sizes, lashed down with cargo NETTING and tensioned STRAPS, clamped to the deck with magnetic locks, sides stencilled with hazard chevrons, barcodes, serial numbers and 'S.V. DROSS' markings, scuffed paint, dented corrugated panels, blinking status lights. The whole hold is strung floor-to-ceiling with translucent ALIEN WEBBING and warm clusters of leathery GLOWING coral-red EGGS nested between the containers and into wall vents. Breath-fog in the cold air, failing amber floodlights catching the silken strands. At the centre, a gaudy GOLD-TRIMMED salvaged escape pod half-cocooned in webbing. Cathedral-huge, alive, coral-red organic growth against grimy slate-grey industrial steel. A webbed alien nest in a working starship hold — egg-laden, dripping, ominous yet faintly comic. NOT small cardboard cartons, NOT a flooded warehouse.
deck-d-salvaged-pod: Grimy, lived-in used-future garbage barge, Red Dwarf comic register. Centre-frame hero: a derelict FOUNDER-CLASS LUXURY ESCAPE POD — a fat ovoid lifeboat with GAUDY GOLD TRIM and an embossed MONOGRAMMED CREST, now scratched, frosted and absurdly fancy amid a grimy industrial cargo hold of dented steel crates. Its round HATCH HANGS OPEN, dark and empty inside, draped and strung with translucent alien WEBBING trailing out of the opening. Cold breath-fog, failing floodlight glow, a few coral-red egg sacs clinging to the gold hull. Incongruous billionaire luxury wrecked in a working-class garbage hold.
deck-d-cargo-airlock: Grimy, lived-in used-future garbage barge, Red Dwarf comic register. The aft wall of a freezing cargo hold dominated by a MASSIVE round industrial CARGO AIRLOCK — a huge circular VAULT DOOR, easily forklift-sized, set into riveted bulkhead, ringed with a glowing TEAL status ring and yellow-and-black hazard chevrons. Beside it, a heavy mechanical CYCLE LEVER and a control panel with a big red override. A small inner PORTHOLE shows the black of space and stars beyond. Frost around the seal, breath-fog, failing amber floods. The obvious, ominous way to vent something very large. Clearly a giant sealable airlock door, not an open tunnel mouth.
